Emtek Hercules Lever

Emtek Classic Brass Leverset Collection. Classic Rope design rosette combined with Early American Twisted Rustic design Lever.

Features:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Lever Length: 3-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-1/4"
    • --->
  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" - 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • Standard 2-3/8" Backset - Optional 2-3/4" Backset
  • Fits all pre-drilled Doors
  • Available in 7 Finishes
  • Handed Levers
  • Sold as Complete Set
  • Solid Brass Construction
  • Easy to Install

Available Functions:

    Double Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock. Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock. Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
